about: What demo/stewart-crossover asks, what it plants, and how each answer is judged, frozen before any of it is asked. Wren Castellano is fiction; Patrick Stewart is not, and every word about him in her files is one of the lines below.

facts.sentence: In 2023, Stewart became a best-selling author upon the publication of his memoir, Making It So.
He returned to the franchise for Star Trek: Picard, which ran from 2020 to 2023.
The series concluded its third and final season in April 2023.
He reprised the role in the Paramount+ series Star Trek: Picard.
In 1987 Stewart took on the role of Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation.
Stewart played Professor Xavier in the X-Men film franchise.
Stewart was born in 1940 in Mirfield.

hit_rule: The kernel's own: a passage answers when it holds half the question's content words (kernel.rank). claim-check's 'all parts' is a passage holding every part; quote-check's 'verbatim' is the same characters, 'same words' the same words in order.

pass_rules.facts: Each fact: claim-check on the sources box finds 'all parts' passages from at least two publishers.
pass_rules.facts-trusted: Each fact: one of its 'all parts' passages is from a host willow-mcp's web_search._trusted_host trusts.
pass_rules.facts-grove: Each fact: willows-grove's seat_say.run_checks passes on its sentence, citing a box for each 'all parts' passage (at most six), with those boxes.
pass_rules.quotes: Each quote: quote-check on the sources box finds it verbatim.
pass_rules.T1: claim-check on the sources box finds no 'all parts' passage for T1's claim (exit 42).
pass_rules.T2: quote-check on the sources box doesn't find T2's quote (exit 42), and misquote names a passage of the source that holds quote2 as the closest.
pass_rules.T3: claim-check on the sources box finds no 'all parts' passage for T3's claim (exit 42).
pass_rules.T4: quote-check on the sources box finds T4's quote as 'same words' and never 'verbatim', in the boqwi-q source; the kernel's words for it and for "Qapla'" are the same (the case words-tlh's card says the kernel can't see).
pass_rules.T5: claim-check on the sources box finds no 'all parts' passage for T5's claim (exit 42), and finds its truth whole in sources from at least two publishers: the two side by side.
pass_rules.death: claim-check on Wren's box finds no 'all parts' passage (exit 42): her files, ending 2026-10-22, don't hold his death.
pass_rules.dates: No date in Wren's files is after 2026-10-22.
pass_rules.G1: claim-check on the all box lists a passage of the parody file among those holding every part of the question: Gerald shows up.
pass_rules.G2: claim-check on the sources box finds no 'all parts' passage (exit 42): the parody is in no source.
pass_rules.K1: words-tlh's bite on the all box answers (exit 0) with a passage of boqwi-q.
pass_rules.M1: make-it-so plans the order on the all box (exit 0) and check says it holds (exit 0); the command is never run.
pass_rules.unseen: Every line of Wren's files that matches 'names' holds a fact sentence, a quote's line, a trap's line or a fiction line verbatim; any other is unseen, never sound (the rule of Forge's measure_panel).
pass_rules.fiction: Every file of Wren's begins with a line saying she is fiction.
pass_rules.verify: kernel.py verify passes on the verdict box, by Willow's kernel and by willow-bot's one-script kernel.
